title: Settings card: 2025 Husqvarna TE 300
ig_caption:
2025 Husqvarna TE 300. About 170 lb, fast, hard enduro. Left is stock from the 2025 Husqvarna owner's manual, right is the baseline Dialed built for that rider.

Fork comp 15 to 12 and rebound 17 to 12. Shock low-speed 15 to 10, high-speed 2 turns to 1, rebound 15 to 12. Sag stays at the manual's 110 mm. A fast rider loads the bike harder, so it gets more support and slower rebound to keep the tires on the rocks.

All clicks counted out from fully closed. Starting points, not a law: ride it, log how it felt, move one thing at a time.

What are you running on yours for the gnarly stuff?

#husqvarna #te300 #hardenduro #suspension #dialedoffroad
